verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's Payments API v3 documents payment mandates for recurring payments. Three mandate types are covered: Sweeping VRPs, Wave 1 VRPs and Direct Debits. Payments created on an authorised mandate execute immediately without further user authorisation, which matches the story's VRP, standing-consent and recurring-debit options. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the mandate flows, and detail on mandate limits, constraints and revocation.
